description: Fork of exp072 (val=1.6975 @ 8K). Replace qk_joint TinyMultiHeadLut + qk_v2d ranking with two plain nn.Linear(96, 6*64=384) projections (Q and K). Outputs go directly to SDPA at dim d_qk=64 (vs exp072's 2016). V LUT and out_proj rank-canonicalize unchanged. Net delta -75M params (167.05M -> ~92M). Isolates whether LUT Q/K + V2D pulls weight vs a standard linear attention head.
